| PM-16 | Plan Schedule Management | Define how activities, dates, dependencies, and progress will be managed. | Scope structure, lifecycle, constraints, calendars, governance rules | Schedule approach, measurement rules, update cadence, thresholds | Use milestone tracking for small work; detailed schedule control for high-dependency work. | Schedule ownership, update source, dependency treatment, and tolerance are explicit. | Drafts approach; PM accepts material schedule controls. | 2.3.2.1 |
